_doc: Mid-boss registry (중간보스). Single source for tools/build_mboss_core.py, build_mboss_arena.py and every boss module generator.
n: stable numeric id used by the generated dispatchers F:mboss/d/<hook> (#mbId mb); never reuse a number.
enabled: false keeps an entry out of the game (no runtime registry line, no dispatch) until its module F:mboss/<id>/ exists.
w: roll weight (0 = only through #mbForce, i.e. tests). minCh/maxCh: chapter range.
hp/xp/atk: level-1 base HP, kill XP and base hit (raw damage before the hit coefficient). lvAdd: level offset over the zone formula.
dmgMul: % applied to every hit on the player. goldMul: kill gold multiplier (normal mobs x1, chapter boss x15). sap: sapphire shards on kill.
el: default element of the boss's hits (#elem numbering: 0 physical 1 pyro 2 hydro 3 electro 4 cryo 5 geo 6 anemo 7 dendro).
scale: hitbox husk scale attribute. hit: click-shield size {w,h} in blocks. intro/death: maximum intro / death-sequence ticks.
picks: item selections granted on kill (chapter rarity). icon: gate object item {item,model}. start: optional arrival override (else arena.start).
--- schema v2 (chapter bosses, AZ-CM; scratchpad az/contract/cm.md section 2) ---

kind: "mid" (default) or "chapter". Chapter entries go to rlk:mboss creg[] / cbyid.<id> (never reg[] / byid: the mid-boss roll never sees them); they need w 0, goldMul 1, sap 0, picks 0 and minCh..maxCh covering ch.
ch: chapters this chapter boss ends (routing, F:mboss/cb/route); [] = never routed (cproto). route: false = routing skips it (only #cbForce in a test reaches it).
arena: the arena id, "plaza" (default: the top-level arena) or a key of arenas{}. theme on a boss entry is informational only (the arena's own theme rules).

music: {ph: {ev: minecraft:music.* sound event, len: ticks (0 = play once)}}, ph = "1".."9" (F:mboss/music/set {ph}). res: per-element RES % {"0".."8", "*" = the rest} on the body (rlk_mb_resel, mbRes0..8).

phases: pool split in % of #mbTot (phases[0] applied at spawn when < 100; the module calls mboss/repool for the later ones). px: hit-proxy boss (proxies from its rig manifest, rlk_mb_big body). pxBase: low byte of the first proxy UUID (default 65, at most 16 proxies).
shield: false = no click shield in any state (rlk_mb_noshield; default for px bosses). hit: click-shield size, default {w:1.0,h:1.0} when shield is false.

arenas{}: every non-plaza arena {n (= #mbAr, unique, never reused; the plaza is 0), theme (T:mboss_arena_<theme>.py), ver, cx cy cz, r walk safe, start, box, looks (looks[0] = the default), oob {y0,y1} (default cy-3..cy+16), sweep {y0,y1} (barrier band swept by cb/won, cleanup, cb/remove)}.
Reserved: boss n 11 and arena n 2 (Apep, chapter 3: ap_oasis).
